verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair axis for a CLI and SaaS developer tool, but the evidence never mentions telemetry or usage-tracking controls. The `gt config` menu is described only with branch and PR settings. The AI privacy docs cover a different subject: AI features being opt-in, no training on customer data, and an org-wide AI block requested by email. None of these show a way to opt out of usage telemetry.
